entries.name: motionsites-web-builder
entries.description: Free MIT Claude skill by MotionSites: Claude studies the most-liked designs, picks real cinematic media (50+ hero videos, 30 transparent 3D cut-outs, 40 example prompts, 55+ technique recipes), writes a build spec, builds, then screenshots its own page and fixes it until it clears a gallery-level bar. Works in Claude.ai Skills and Claude Code.
entries.install_method: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add Motionsites-AI/claude-skill; /plugin install motionsites-web-builder@motionsites. Claude.ai/desktop: upload motionsites-web-builder.zip from the upstream latest release via Customize > Skills. Optional: pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium
entries.verification: Verified exact public match: upstream README is titled 'MotionSites Web Builder: a free Claude skill' and its SKILL.md name is motionsites-web-builder, matching the reel's content. The reel's DM payload is unverified (gated behind a SITE comment, never posted on Kushal's behalf) and unnecessary - the skill is public on GitHub.
entries.removal: Delete installed/motionsites-web-builder/ and remove this entry from registry.json and REGISTRY.md, then append a removal event to history.jsonl.

entries.name: Anatomy
entries.description: Claude Code skill that explains a technical idea by building it as a real working object: name an idea in one line and Claude invents a machine that does it, drawn as a live interactive isometric figure (SVG/WebGL) whose numbers come from the same model that moves its parts. Also runs in OpenCode and Codex.
entries.install_method: npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g -a claude-code; then /anatomy explain how <idea> works, interactive

entries.name: Brag (/brag)
entries.description: Claude Code skill that turns the project you just built into a short shareable launch video with music, motion and share copy in one command (/brag), powered by HyperFrames. Reads project code directly; includes a lean /brag-slim variant.

entries.name: REA — Reverse Engineer Anything
entries.description: MCP server + CLI that lets a coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) look inside an app you do not have source for and explain how a feature works, down to the binary level, then rebuild your own version. Uses Ghidra/Hopper/IDA for native apps and built-in analysis for JS/Electron/.NET/Android/web.
entries.install_method: npx rea-agents setup (Node.js + npm required; adds REA's MCP server to chosen agents, restart after)
entries.verification: Strong public function match: caption describes pointing a coding agent at any app to learn how it works inside and rebuild liked features without stealing source; REA matches exactly and was GitHub #1 trending in Oct 2026.
